description: This is a Java interface defining generic data access object (DAO) methods for entities in the SalesManager application. It specifies CRUD operations, counting, querying by fields, and managing the EntityManager.

classes.name: SalesManagerEntityDao
classes.description: Generic DAO interface for entity operations, with methods for CRUD, counting, and querying entities by fields.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Retrieve an entity by class type and ID.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieve an entity directly by its ID.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refresh the state of an entity.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flush pending changes to the database.

methods.name: countByField
methods.description: Count entities matching a field value.

methods.name: listByField
methods.description: List entities matching a field value.

methods.name: getByField
methods.description: Retrieve a single entity matching a field value.

methods.name: list
methods.description: List entities with filter, limit, offset, and order.
